sentences.text: Andi menuang adonan ke dalam mangkuk besar sambil mendengarkan instruktur.

sentences.ko: 안디는 강사 말을 들으면서 반죽을 큰 그릇에 부었어요.

sentences.text: Dewi menyimpan surat-surat dari Rani di sebuah mangkuk keramik tua di atas meja.
sentences.en: Dewi keeps the letters from Rani in an old ceramic bowl on the table.
sentences.ko: 데위는 라니에게 받은 편지들을 탁자 위 낡은 도자기 그릇에 넣어 둬요.

sentences.text: Hari ini peserta kelas belajar membuat sosis ayam sendiri.
sentences.en: Today the class participants are learning to make their own chicken sausages.
sentences.ko: 오늘 수업 참가자들은 닭고기 소시지를 직접 만드는 법을 배워요.

sentences.text: Dewi bercerita kepada Rani tentang sosis bakar yang dulu mereka beli di depan sekolah.
sentences.en: Dewi told Rani about the grilled sausages they used to buy in front of school.
sentences.ko: 데위는 라니에게 예전에 학교 앞에서 사 먹던 구운 소시지 얘기를 했어요.

sentences.text: Andi mengiris tomat tipis-tipis untuk hiasan salad.
sentences.en: Andi sliced the tomatoes thinly to garnish the salad.
sentences.ko: 안디는 샐러드 장식용으로 토마토를 얇게 썰었어요.

sentences.text: Dalam suratnya, Dewi bilang tanaman tomat di balkonnya mulai berbuah.
sentences.en: In her letter, Dewi said the tomato plants on her balcony have started bearing fruit.
sentences.ko: 데위는 편지에 베란다의 토마토가 열매를 맺기 시작했다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Kalau masakanku dapat nilai terbaik, aku traktir kalian semua, kata Andi.
sentences.en: If my dish gets the best score, I'll treat you all, Andi said.
sentences.ko: 내 요리가 최고 점수를 받으면 다 한턱낼게, 하고 안디가 말했어요.

sentences.text: Dewi berjanji akan traktir Rani makan malam kalau Rani datang ke kotanya.
sentences.en: Dewi promised to treat Rani to dinner if Rani came to her city.
sentences.ko: 데위는 라니가 자기 도시에 오면 저녁을 사겠다고 약속했어요.

sentences.text: Instruktur mengajari Andi merebus telur supaya kuningnya tetap lembut.
sentences.en: The instructor taught Andi to boil eggs so the yolks stay soft.
sentences.ko: 강사는 안디에게 노른자가 부드럽게 남도록 달걀 삶는 법을 가르쳤어요.

sentences.text: Dewi ingat ibunya selalu merebus jagung setiap kali Rani menginap.
sentences.en: Dewi remembers her mother always boiled corn whenever Rani stayed over.
sentences.ko: 데위는 라니가 자고 갈 때마다 어머니가 옥수수를 삶아 주셨던 걸 기억해요.

sentences.text: Andi menghancurkan biskuit untuk dijadikan dasar kue keju.
sentences.en: Andi crushed biscuits to make the base for the cheesecake.
sentences.ko: 안디는 치즈케이크 바닥을 만들려고 비스킷을 부쉈어요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengirim sekaleng biskuit mentega bersama suratnya.
sentences.en: Dewi sent a tin of butter biscuits along with her letter.
sentences.ko: 데위는 편지와 함께 버터 비스킷 한 통을 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Andi baru pertama kali memanggang roti dengan oven besar milik sekolah masak.
sentences.en: It was Andi's first time baking bread in the cooking school's big oven.
sentences.ko: 안디는 요리 학교의 큰 오븐으로 빵을 처음 구워 봤어요.

sentences.text: Rani menulis bahwa sekarang ia suka memanggang kue setiap akhir pekan.
sentences.en: Rani wrote that she now likes baking cakes every weekend.
sentences.ko: 라니는 요즘 주말마다 케이크 굽는 게 좋다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Peserta kelas diajari cara membersihkan kepiting tanpa terjepit capitnya.
sentences.en: The class was taught how to clean a crab without getting pinched by its claws.
sentences.ko: 참가자들은 집게에 물리지 않고 게를 손질하는 법을 배웠어요.

sentences.text: Dewi masih ingat makan kepiting saus padang bersama Rani di pantai.
sentences.en: Dewi still remembers eating chili crab with Rani at the beach.
sentences.ko: 데위는 라니와 해변에서 파당 소스 게를 먹던 걸 아직 기억해요.

sentences.text: Andi menaburkan gula halus di atas donat yang masih hangat.

sentences.ko: 안디는 아직 따뜻한 도넛 위에 슈가파우더를 뿌렸어요.

sentences.ko: 라니는 둘이 자주 가던 도넛 가게가 문을 닫았다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Andi belajar mengupas udang dan membuang kotorannya dengan pisau kecil.

sentences.text: Dewi menceritakan kerupuk udang buatan neneknya yang selalu habis dalam sehari.
sentences.en: Dewi wrote about her grandmother's shrimp crackers that were always gone within a day.
sentences.ko: 데위는 늘 하루 만에 동나던 할머니표 새우 과자 얘기를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Sayuran untuk kelas ini dipasok dari kebun organik di pinggir kota.
sentences.en: The vegetables for this class are supplied by an organic farm on the edge of town.
sentences.ko: 이 수업 채소는 도시 외곽의 유기농 농장에서 들어와요.

sentences.ko: 라니는 지금 유기농 농장에서 일하고 데위에게 논 사진을 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Andi kaget karena saus buatannya terasa pahit akibat bawang putihnya gosong.

sentences.ko: 안디는 마늘이 타서 소스가 쓴맛이 나 깜짝 놀랐어요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengaku kopi tanpa gula masih terlalu pahit baginya.
sentences.en: Dewi admitted that coffee without sugar is still too bitter for her.

sentences.text: Dewi menulis resep kolak labu yang dulu sering mereka makan saat buka puasa.
sentences.en: Dewi wrote down the pumpkin kolak recipe they often ate when breaking the fast.
sentences.ko: 데위는 둘이 금식을 깰 때 자주 먹던 호박 콜락 요리법을 적었어요.

sentences.text: Andi bermimpi membuka kafe kecil setelah lulus kelas masak.
sentences.en: Andi dreams of opening a small café after finishing cooking class.
sentences.ko: 안디는 요리 수업을 마치면 작은 카페를 여는 꿈을 꿔요.

sentences.text: Dewi sering menulis surat untuk Rani di sebuah kafe dekat kantornya.
sentences.en: Dewi often writes letters to Rani at a café near her office.
sentences.ko: 데위는 회사 근처 카페에서 라니에게 편지를 자주 써요.

sentences.text: Roti yang dibuat Andi memakai tepung gandum utuh.
sentences.en: The bread Andi made uses whole wheat flour.
sentences.ko: 안디가 만든 빵은 통밀가루를 써요.

sentences.text: Dalam suratnya, Rani bilang ladang gandum di desanya sudah menguning.
sentences.en: In her letter, Rani said the wheat fields in her village have turned golden.
sentences.ko: 라니는 편지에 마을 밀밭이 누렇게 익었다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Andi mengoleskan selai stroberi buatan sendiri ke roti panggang.
sentences.en: Andi spread homemade strawberry jam on the toast.
sentences.ko: 안디는 직접 만든 딸기잼을 토스트에 발랐어요.

sentences.text: Dewi berterima kasih atas selai nanas yang dikirim Rani bulan lalu.
sentences.en: Dewi thanked Rani for the pineapple jam she sent last month.
sentences.ko: 데위는 라니가 지난달 보내 준 파인애플 잼에 고마워했어요.

sentences.text: Kulit pai buatan Andi retak karena adonannya terlalu kering.
sentences.en: The crust of Andi's pie cracked because the dough was too dry.
sentences.ko: 반죽이 너무 말라서 안디가 만든 파이 껍질이 갈라졌어요.

sentences.text: Dewi bercerita tentang pai apel pertama yang ia buat untuk ulang tahun ibunya.
sentences.en: Dewi wrote about the first apple pie she made for her mother's birthday.
sentences.ko: 데위는 어머니 생신에 처음 만든 사과 파이 얘기를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Untuk kelas spesial akhir tahun, Andi belajar memanggang daging kalkun utuh.

sentences.text: Rani menulis bahwa keluarga suaminya selalu makan kalkun panggang saat hari raya.

sentences.ko: 데위는 예전 기숙사 근처 가게의 닭죽이 그리워요.

sentences.ko: 라니는 자기 동네 바닷바람이 아침마다 짭짤하다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Andi memasukkan mi setelah air di panci mendidih.

sentences.ko: 데위는 차 끓일 물이 끓기를 기다리며 라니의 편지를 다시 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Dewi menulis bahwa cahaya lampu kendaraan di malam hari sering membutakan matanya.
sentences.en: Dewi wrote that car headlights at night often blind her.
sentences.ko: 데위는 밤에 차 불빛 때문에 자주 눈이 부시다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Menurut Andi, membuat adonan kue sus termasuk teknik yang paling sukar.

sentences.ko: 데위는 새 도시에서 라니만큼 가까운 친구를 찾기 어렵다고 털어놨어요.

sentences.text: Kucing pemilik sekolah masak mendengkur di dekat jendela dapur.
sentences.en: The cooking school owner's cat purred near the kitchen window.
sentences.ko: 요리 학교 주인의 고양이가 부엌 창가에서 골골거렸어요.

sentences.text: Dewi bercerita bahwa suaminya mendengkur keras setiap malam.
sentences.en: Dewi wrote that her husband snores loudly every night.
sentences.ko: 데위는 남편이 밤마다 코를 크게 곤다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Sekolah masak itu juga menyewakan dapurnya untuk acara ulang tahun.
sentences.en: The cooking school also rents out its kitchen for birthday parties.
sentences.ko: 그 요리 학교는 생일 파티용으로 부엌을 빌려주기도 해요.

sentences.text: Rani sekarang menyewakan kamar kosong di rumahnya untuk mahasiswa.
sentences.en: Rani now rents out the empty room in her house to university students.
sentences.ko: 라니는 지금 집의 빈방을 대학생에게 세놓아요.

sentences.text: Para peserta berpelukan di akhir kelas setelah menerima sertifikat.

sentences.ko: 참가자들은 수료증을 받고 수업이 끝날 때 서로 껴안았어요.

sentences.text: Dewi menempelkan foto mereka berpelukan saat wisuda di surat itu.
sentences.en: Dewi attached a photo of them hugging at graduation to the letter.
sentences.ko: 데위는 졸업식 때 둘이 껴안고 찍은 사진을 편지에 붙였어요.

sentences.text: Kelas memanggang roti minggu ini tertunda karena ovennya rusak.
sentences.en: This week's bread-baking class was postponed because the oven broke.
sentences.ko: 오븐이 고장 나서 이번 주 빵 굽기 수업이 미뤄졌어요.

sentences.text: Rencana Dewi mengunjungi Rani tertunda lagi karena urusan kantor.
sentences.en: Dewi's plan to visit Rani was postponed again because of work.
sentences.ko: 라니를 찾아가려던 데위의 계획은 회사 일 때문에 또 미뤄졌어요.

sentences.text: Aroma bawang goreng membuat selera makan Andi langsung terangsang.
sentences.en: The smell of fried shallots immediately whetted Andi's appetite.
sentences.ko: 튀긴 샬롯 냄새에 안디는 곧바로 입맛이 돌았어요.

sentences.text: Rani menulis bahwa rasa ingin tahunya terangsang setelah membaca buku sejarah kiriman Dewi.

sentences.ko: 라니는 데위가 보낸 역사책을 읽고 호기심이 생겼다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Rasa gugup sempat melanda Andi saat ujian praktik dimulai.

sentences.ko: 실기 시험이 시작되자 안디는 잠깐 긴장감에 휩싸였어요.

sentences.text: Rani bercerita bahwa banjir sempat melanda desanya bulan lalu.

sentences.ko: 라니는 지난달 마을에 홍수가 났었다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Instruktur memperbaiki genggaman Andi pada pisau agar jarinya aman.

sentences.en: Dewi remembers Rani's grip on her hand when they said goodbye at the station.

sentences.ko: 데위의 할머니는 금목걸이를 첫 손녀에게 물려주고 싶어 하세요.

sentences.text: Rani menulis bahwa teka-teki silang yang dikirim Dewi akhirnya terpecahkan juga.
sentences.en: Rani wrote that the crossword Dewi sent had finally been solved.
sentences.ko: 라니는 데위가 보낸 십자말풀이를 드디어 풀었다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Kalau mau hasilnya bagus, ukuran potongan sayur harus konsisten, kata instruktur.

sentences.ko: 결과가 좋으려면 채소 크기가 일정해야 한다고 강사가 말했어요.

sentences.text: Selama belasan tahun, Dewi konsisten membalas surat Rani setiap bulan.
sentences.en: For more than ten years, Dewi has consistently replied to Rani's letters every month.
sentences.ko: 십수 년 동안 데위는 매달 꾸준히 라니의 편지에 답장했어요.

sentences.text: Andi sebetulnya tidak suka makanan pedas, tapi tetap mencicipi sambal buatan temannya.
sentences.en: Andi doesn't actually like spicy food, but he still tasted his friend's chili sauce.
sentences.ko: 안디는 사실 매운 음식을 안 좋아하지만 친구가 만든 삼발을 맛봤어요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengaku sebetulnya ia iri dengan kehidupan tenang Rani di desa.
sentences.en: Dewi admitted she's actually envious of Rani's quiet life in the village.
sentences.ko: 데위는 사실 라니의 조용한 시골 생활이 부럽다고 털어놨어요.

sentences.text: Adonan roti Andi membesar dua kali lipat setelah didiamkan satu jam.
sentences.en: Andi's bread dough doubled in size after resting for an hour.
sentences.ko: 안디의 빵 반죽은 한 시간 두었더니 두 배로 부풀었어요.

sentences.text: Rani bercerita bahwa usaha kue kecilnya mulai membesar sejak tahun lalu.
sentences.en: Rani wrote that her small cake business has been growing since last year.
sentences.ko: 라니는 작은 케이크 장사가 작년부터 커지기 시작했다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Pihak sekolah menginformasikan lewat pesan bahwa kelas besok dimulai lebih awal.
sentences.en: The school notified everyone by message that tomorrow's class starts earlier.
sentences.ko: 학교 측은 내일 수업이 더 일찍 시작한다고 메시지로 알렸어요.

sentences.text: Dewi menginformasikan alamat barunya kepada Rani di akhir surat.
sentences.en: Dewi gave Rani her new address at the end of the letter.
sentences.ko: 데위는 편지 끝에 라니에게 새 주소를 알려 줬어요.

sentences.text: Sekolah masak itu rutin memanggil petugas untuk membasmi semut di gudang tepung.
sentences.en: The cooking school regularly calls in someone to get rid of ants in the flour storeroom.
sentences.ko: 그 요리 학교는 밀가루 창고의 개미를 없애려고 정기적으로 업체를 불러요.

sentences.text: Rani menulis bahwa warga desanya bergotong royong membasmi hama tikus di sawah.
sentences.en: Rani wrote that her villagers worked together to wipe out the rats in the rice fields.
sentences.ko: 라니는 마을 사람들이 힘을 모아 논의 쥐를 없앴다고 썼어요.
